captions: Here's a question.
If your money grows at eight percent a
year, how long until it doubles?
There's a trick that answers it in your
head.
It's called the Rule of 72.
Divide seventy two by the yearly growth rate.
The answer is roughly how many years it
takes your money to double.
At eight percent, seventy two divided by eight
is nine.
So one lakh becomes two lakh in about
nine years. Four lakh by eighteen. Eight lakh
by twenty seven.
Every nine years, it doubles again.
Now change the rate.
At four percent, doubling takes eighteen years. At
twelve percent, just six.
Triple the rate, and the wait shrinks to
a third.
So small differences in rate make huge differences
in time.
Seventy two, divided by the rate. Keep that
number in your pocket.
